summary.text: Justin Pizzulli is a Republican state representative who has represented Ohio House District 90 since being appointed on May 11, 2023, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Pizzulli was appointed to replace Rep. Brian Baldridge (R).
He defeated Gina Collinsworth and Timothy Wheeler in the March 19, 2024 Republican primary and Democrat Kate Nunnelley in the November 5, 2024 general election.
Ballotpedia lists his committees as Commerce and Labor, Financial Institutions (vice chair), Government Oversight and Transportation.
Collin Docterman is the Democratic candidate in the 2026 general election.
